evidence.notes: Unknown async save-result locator strings are rejected instead of returning fabricated pending results.
String async save-result locator lookup requires a known local locator.
Unknown async delete-result locator strings are rejected instead of returning fabricated pending results.
String async delete-result locator lookup requires a known local locator.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseAsyncResultLocatorRejectionTest { @isTest static void unknownLocatorStringsAreRejected() { Boolean saveCaught = false; try { Object saveResult = Database.getAsyncSaveResult('missing-local-save-result'); System.assert(false); } catch (Exception e) { saveCaught = e.getMessage().contains('unknown async DML result locator'); } System.assert(saveCaught); Boolean deleteCaught = false; try { Object deleteResult = Database.getAsyncDeleteResult('missing-local-delete-result'); System.assert(false); } catch (Exception e) { deleteCaught = e.getMessage().contains('unknown async DML result locator'); } System.assert(deleteCaught); } }
